title: Handley Page Hampden AT219
memorial_details:
Plain, black, rectangular tablet (material unknown) with dedication in upper and lower-case script. This crew is also commemorated on the memorial wall at North Hykeham (99778)

The memorial is located at RAF Waddington, which suggests a strong connection to the local community and its military presence.
inscription: IN MEMORY/ ON THE 14TH APRIL 1942 A HANDLEY PAGE HAMPDEN B1 AIRCRAFT NO. AT219 OF THE/ RCAF SQUADRON 420 BASED AT RAF WADDINGTON CRASHED AT THIS SITE SHORTLY AFTER/ TAKE-OFF WHILST ATTEMPTING TO RETURN TO BASE FOLLOWING THE FAILURE OF BOTH ENGINES./ TRAGICALLY ALL 4 AIRMEN ON BOARD LOST THEIR LIVES./ (names)/ FOUR BRAVE YOUNG MEN - YOU WILL BE REMEMBERED
community_connection: The memorial is maintained by North Kesteven Acadany.
